newsitem.title: USA: First Union Real Estate CEO comments on FFO.
newsitem.headline: First Union Real Estate CEO comments on FFO.

text.p: First Union Real Estate Investments chief executive officer James Mastandrea said Wednesday he estimates funds per share from operations for 1996 will be $0.93-$0.95.
In 1995, the real estate investment trust had $0.92 FFO.

Mastandrea, who is also chairman and president, after a presentation to analysts, was asked if the real estate investment trust results would be within First Call's range of analysts' estimates of $0.88-$0.95.
"I'm calling it $0.93-$0.95 funds from operations," he told reporters.
Mastandrea said First Union is considering adding hotels to its portfolio, now primarily apartments and retail properties.

He also said a tenant has been signed for the new Westgate Towne Centre open-air shopping center in Abilene, Texas but declined to name the tenant. First Union plans to demolish a mall it owns to build the new "power center".
